overview:
Last updated: Thu Apr 30 2026

OVERVIEW

Vallejo CA PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Vallejo CA PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Vallejo CA PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.

POLICIES

success_stories:
INCIDENT #1
Raven Alert: Multiple Gunshot Alert on 05/12/25 at 06:16PM at 2500 blk Sonoma Blvd.
Dispatch CFS:
25-4619: 05/12/25 at 06:17PM Raven alerted to multiple gunshots heard in the area of 2500 blk Sonoma Blvd. A
victim called and stated that a subject had shot at his vehicle, and he had been struck once in the stomach. One adult
victim was located with non-life-threatening injuries.
Original CFS was in the area of Broadway/ Tennessee St.
Actual scene and RAVEN gunshot alert was in the 2500 blk of Sonoma Blvd.

INCIDENT #2
Raven Alert: Multiple gunshots alert on 10/06/24 at 1:35AM close to 500blk Capitol St.
Dispatch CFS:
24-10161: 10/06/24  1:36AM/ Corner of Capitol St. & Marin St.
Victim was shot and unable to call 911 prior to being found by officers. Suspect contacted and arrested with firearm recovered

INCIDENT #3
VPD Officers were dispatched to the area of Florida St. and Mare Island Way after receiving a notification from CHP about a wanted felony vehicle. This suspect vehicle fled from Folsom PD earlier in the day and led officers on a county wide pursuit making threats to commit suicide by cop. According to CHP and info per Flock, the vehicle was now in this area of Vallejo. A VPD officer conducted a Flock ALPR search and was able to find a specific area of where the suspect vehicle was last seen. During their area check, Officers located the vehicle and were able to take the suspect into custody without incident.
